    --disable-shared \
    --without-debug \
    --without-http \
    --without-python

make clean-corpus
make fuzz.o

for fuzzer in html regexp schema uri valid xinclude xml xpath; do

    # Link with $CXX

        $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE \
        ../.libs/libxml2.a -Wl,-Bstatic -lz -llzma -Wl,-Bdynamic
